Cadence 0.4.0 adds clearer ways to see and compare how the room affects an agent.

- `cadence demo` runs the same prompt through synthetic rooms using the real
  Cadence pipeline, with an optional no-Cadence baseline.
- Manually enabled macOS Focus can nudge proactivity; stronger user and work
  signals still take precedence.
- Optional Chrome audio detection and duration-weighted music history make
  the room less sensitive to one outlier track.
- Releases now verify both plugin manifests and the packed consumer install,
  publish the tested tarball, confirm its npm integrity, and create the GitHub
  release at the same commit through one explicitly triggered workflow.

Install through `cadence@cadence` in the Claude Code marketplace, then use
the normal plugin update/reload flow for an existing installation.
